title: Press
intro: Star Splitter Visions publishes independent comics and graphic stories across science fiction, comedy, and speculative drama. Each series begins with a strange premise and follows the people who have to live with it.

cards.title: Publisher overview
cards.body: Published titles include Vikings 2026!, Backyard Rockets, Rex Fleet, Azure Reach, and Stardust Station. Additional stories are in development.

cards.title: Press materials
cards.body: Use public series names, descriptions, and artwork as presented on the site. A downloadable press kit should remain a separate scoped release when final approved assets are ready.
